THIS CRIMINAL MISC. CASE HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 16.11.2023, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 Crl. M.C. No.7962/2023 -3-  ORDER

The petitioners are the accused in Crime No.365/2023 of Thamarassery Police Station, Kozhikode District which is now pending as C.C.No.276/2023 before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Thamarassery.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Thamarassery
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioners face prosecution under Sections 323 and 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

2. When the matter is taken up for consideration today it is the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners that all issues between the petitioner and the 3rd respondent (de facto complainant) have been settled.
He also produced an affidavit of 3rd respondent as Annexure-A2.

3. Heard the learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for 3 rd respondent also.
4.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the fact that all issues between the petitioners and the 3 rd respondent have been settled and also considering Annexure-A2 affidavit of 3 rd respondent, I am of the view that this is fit case where, the jurisdiction of this Court under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. can be invoked and the proceedings against the petitioners can be quashed on the ground of settlement.
No public purpose would be served by continuing with the proceedings against the petitioners.
In the result, this Crl.M.C. is allowed and all further proceedings against the petitioners, in C.C.No.276/2023 before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Thamarassery will stand quashed.
